entities.summary: Don Reid is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the Detroit Pistons in the second round of the 1995 NBA draft. In his career, Reid played for the Pistons, Washington Wizards and Orlando Magic in 8 NBA seasons. In his 1995-96 rookie season as a member of the Pistons, he averaged 3.8 points in 69 games played. He played collegiately at Georgetown University.
